note: Normative inventory of Design System components. Prefer extending an entry over inventing a parallel control. Every entry has a docs page; the sidebar (src/lib/navigation.ts) and the /components index group them by the job they do.

components.name: AppIcon
components.notes: Brand logos via Simple Icons (CC0) when the app name matches the catalog (SAP, Salesforce, AWS, Google); otherwise first-letter tile. Product AppBadge appearance="logo" consumes this. Used first on SoD Resolution V3.

components.name: Avatar
components.notes: soft = rounded-square (radius.avatar 6px) for lists; circle = profile cards with grey outline + 2px surface gap. Letter sizes: xs 12 / sm 16 / md 20 / lg 24. See ADR-0009.

components.name: Button
components.notes: One primary per screen (visual-language §5.1). Heights are fixed per size — sm 36 / md 40 / lg 48 — so every control of the same size lines up in a toolbar. A disabled primary keeps a tooltip explaining what unblocks it.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Header uses 15px regular title + 15px filled icon. padding=none keeps a horizontal content gutter so flush-list dividers stay inset. See ADR-0009. The header icon MUST be a FILLED MUI icon: the header forces 15px, where an outlined 1px stroke reads as a smudge. `npm run check:icons` fails the build on any Outlined icon passed to a Card.

components.name: Checkbox
components.notes: The unchecked outline uses border.control, the token added for exactly this: WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 on a control boundary and the hairline borders cannot reach it. Prefer the `label` prop over wrapping in a <label>, which would leave the text dead.

components.name: Radio
components.notes: The single-choice partner to Checkbox, sharing its 18px metrics and the border.control token so single- and multi-select tables align on the same optical column. A radio never un-checks itself, so onChange reports selection rather than a toggle. Consumed by DataTable selectionMode="single".

components.name: DataTable
components.notes: fillHeight takes the remaining height and scrolls its own body with a sticky header and pinned pagination — the page itself never scrolls on a list screen. Give text cells an explicit width, or a long string will push the trailing columns off screen.

components.name: DatePicker
components.notes: Replaces <input type="date">, whose field text, icon and popup are unthemable browser chrome. Value is YYYY-MM-DD and is parsed as a string, never through Date — constructing a Date from it lands on the previous day west of Greenwich. formatDateShort is exported for read-only display.

components.name: Dialog
components.notes: A question and its consequence, nothing more. tone="danger" for destructive confirmations. If it needs form fields, it is a Modal.

components.name: DonutChart
components.notes: SVG part-to-whole breakdown. Categorical colour only; do not reuse the status ramp for categories.

components.name: Drawer
components.notes: Right-anchored panel for long forms and browsing surfaces where the page behind still matters. Use Modal for a short centered form, Dialog for a confirm. elevation.lg.

components.name: FlowCanvas
components.notes: The Automation builders’ derived-layout graph for a *sequence* (ADR-0007: custom, zero-dependency). Cards/lanes in the DOM; connectors are a measured SVG overlay (ResizeObserver → orthogonal fan-out/merge/sequence). Export `FlowStem` for layout-only vertical joins — product code must not paint CSS stems. `renderBetweenTiers` slots chrome between a first branch tier and outcomeBranches. `simulation` drives Test Run visuals (dim edges, node rings, animated success/danger trace). For a *network*, use RelationshipCanvas. `readOnly` renders a saved flow as a preview with no authoring affordances — used by the Approval Policy detail page, so preview and builder are the same picture.

components.name: InfoRow
components.notes: Table-like label/value rows via InfoRowGroup — values share one left edge. Do not right-align or hug the label. `icon` is REQUIRED (TypeScript-enforced): a group of these is a scan column, and one row without an icon breaks it for every row around it. Product code sources icons from the shared `infoIcon` vocabulary (components/product/directory/infoIcons.tsx), which reuses the sidebar icon for each noun.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Shares the control-height scale with Select, DatePicker, TimePicker and Button. Error is driven by the presence of the `error` message, not a separate boolean.

components.name: Menu
components.notes: The ⋮ row-actions dropdown. Destructive items take the danger role and should confirm before acting.

components.name: Meter
components.notes: Tones resolve to the status *fill* roles, not the text roles: a bar is a graphical object under WCAG 1.4.11, and the text roles read heavy as a solid block. Always show the number in text as well — the bar is the shape, not the value.

components.name: Modal
components.notes: Centered counterpart to Drawer, for short forms and rich decisions. Body scrolls; the panel caps at 85vh. showClose=false when dismissing without deciding would leave things inconsistent — the footer must then offer a way back. elevation.xl.

components.name: NavCard
components.notes: Launcher card for landing pages that route into a section. The whole card is one target — never nest interactive elements inside. Counts format with a fixed locale so server and client render the same string.

components.name: NavList
components.notes: Vertical in-panel section switcher, reported as role=tablist. Use over Tabs when labels are long, the set may grow, or each item carries a count. Supplies no chrome of its own — put it inside a bordered panel.

components.name: QuickFilter
components.notes: Standalone single-select filter chips where null means "show all", and clicking the active chip clears it. Chip height follows the shared control scale (sm 36 / md 40) so it lines up with the Input beside it in a table toolbar.

components.name: RadioCardGroup
components.notes: Single-choice selector as icon + label cards. Use when the options need explanation; a bare Select when they do not.

components.name: RelationshipCanvas
components.notes: Layered relationship graph (ADR-0010). Complement to FlowCanvas: that renders a sequence top-down, this renders a typed network as left-to-right columns. Owns column layout, barycenter crossing reduction, bezier edge routing with collision-suppressed labels, zoom/pan/fit, selection and dimming. Custom and zero-dependency for the same reason as FlowCanvas (ADR-0007) — layout is derived, not user-positioned. Frames `frameNodeId` at a legible scale rather than shrinking a wide graph to fit. First consumed by the Governance Model.

components.name: RichTextEditor
components.notes: Uncontrolled contentEditable — writing value back each keystroke would reset the caret. Emits HTML via onChange; use the exported plainText() for emptiness and length validation, since an "empty" editor still contains markup.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.notes: A connected track where exactly one segment is always on — there is no cleared state. If the control needs one, it is a QuickFilter. Cap at four segments; past that use a Select.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Matched to Input so the two align in a form row. Pass ariaLabel when the visible label sits outside the component — otherwise the combobox announces only its value.

components.name: SelectableList
components.notes: Multi-select rows with leading visual, description and trailing content. variant="plain" exists so the list can sit inside an already-bordered panel without becoming a card inside a card. tone="danger" for access about to be revoked.

components.name: SelectionPanel
components.notes: The "what you selected" side panel for multi-select drawers. Pairs with SelectableList when the selection grows long enough to lose track of.

components.name: StatTile
components.notes: KPI tile — label, value, icon in a tinted rounded square. The icon is graphical (WCAG 1.4.11, 3:1) so brand-orange on tint is fine. The only "resting" shadow permitted in the system.

components.name: StatusChip
components.notes: The ONE intent→colour mapping. `caution` is the orange fourth step added so High and Medium stop sharing yellow. Risk scores render through RiskScoreChip (dot=false), never a local pill. whitespace-nowrap: a chip is a single mark and must never wrap its label.

components.name: Stepper
components.notes: Steps keep their number throughout, so "step 2" means the same thing on every screen. showBack=false on a step that owns its own way back (a final review with an explicit Edit). Cap at four steps.

components.name: Switch
components.notes: Contained thumb inside pill track; brand fill when on. Do not use raw MUI Switch in product code.

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: 32px tall — the component owns the height (MUI's block padding is zeroed); never pad the band locally. Selection is marked by colour and a 1px indicator, never by weight, so labels never shift width as the selection moves. Every tab needs its own empty state.

components.name: TimePicker
components.notes: 12-hour display over a 24-hour HH:MM value, so storage never depends on display. Three short columns (hour · minute · period) instead of one long Select of every slot. formatTime12 is exported for read-only display.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Transient feedback with a depleting progress bar, provided through ToastProvider/useToast. Every mutation gives feedback; a toast is not a substitute for an inline error on a field.

components.name: Tooltip
components.notes: label = dark contextual text for a few words; card = light surface panel for rich content, with no arrow (a bordered arrow cannot meet a bordered panel cleanly). The child must forward a ref. A tooltip is never the accessible name — pair with aria-label.
